newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Treasurer Clymer says to resign this summer.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Treasurer Clymer says to resign this summer.

text.p: New Jersey Treasurer Brian Clymer said Wednesday he intends to resign his post this summer.
Clymer, who did not immediately give a reason for his departure, said he would continue to oversee the approval process for Gov. Christine Whitman's fiscal 1998 budget.
The State Legislature is under a June 30 deadline to approve the budget for the fiscal year beginning July 1.
Clymer has served as Treasurer since January 1994.
